name: framer-thumnbails
title: Framer Thumbnail Carousel
description: A large photo sits above a single rail of small previews, where the current one is three times wider than the rest. Choosing a preview widens it, slides the rail and springs the big picture across.
use: One image should dominate while every other option stays visible as a sliver beneath it.
avoid: The photo area is fixed at 400px tall and all eighteen pictures load as previews at once.
a11y: Preview buttons take their name from odd image titles, and no custom focus ring is supplied. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A big rounded photo about 400px tall, with a hairline white chevron circle over each side. Underneath runs one tight row of eighteen upright preview strips about 70px tall; one is clearly wider, roughly three strips' worth, and the rest are narrow slivers.
behaves: Picking a sliver grows it into the wide slot while its neighbours shrink, and the row scrolls itself so the chosen preview sits near the middle. The large photo follows with a spring, and dragging it sideways navigates the same way.
customise: Pictures come from the items array in the file; the open and closed preview widths plus the photo height are constants to edit.
weight: light: One sliding strip and a width change on eighteen small previews; idle when untouched.
demo: Eighteen Unsplash photos: a sunglasses portrait, a sunlit green wall, a blurred figure and a paraglider over sky.
issues: The same made-up titles such as 'SONYPOO' are used as alt text on each photo.
All eighteen previews share one row, leaving each sliver too narrow to aim at.
polishWhy: The expanding preview and centred scroll feel considered; the cramped rail is the weak point.
